description: The Settings surface when opened as a webview needs to listen for settings-refresh events that fire when the roster changes while the window is open (the frame loop push path at frame_loop.rs:710), and to emit settings_event commands when a row is edited. The start-dragging permission is for alt-drag: the page checks modifier held and event.target rather than dragging the whole window unconditionally, so a drag from a text field still selects. Native remains the default; this capability applies only when AI_BUDDY_SETTINGS_WEBVIEW=1. The close permission is for the Escape key: without it close() is denied and Escape does nothing.
